name: Hoverview
author: Abdulrahman Rahmouni
description: Per-monitor workspace numbers with layout shapes that show a live, to-scale layout of each workspace on hover, with the shown tab of every group, a window list, and full-screen peek.

barWidget.description: Workspace number indicators with a live hover preview of each workspace's windows.

schema.label: Persistent workspaces
schema.description: Always show this monitor's workspaces 1 to N, even when empty. 0 shows only occupied workspaces plus the shown one.

schema.label: Label vertical offset
schema.description: Nudge the workspace numbers up (negative) or down (positive) for fonts that sit off-center.

schema.label: Layout shape
schema.description: Draw the active workspace's number on its layout shape (square tiling, circle scrolling, triangle floating) instead of the plain accent pill.

schema.label: Layout shape on every workspace
schema.description: Draw every workspace's number on a faint layout shape, not only the active one.

schema.label: Click to cycle layout
schema.description: Clicking the already-active workspace cycles its layout (tiling, scrolling, floating), like Super + L.

schema.label: Color other monitors
schema.description: Mark the shown workspace on a non-primary monitor's bar in this color instead of the accent.

schema.label: Other monitor color
schema.description: Hex color (#RRGGBB or #AARRGGBB) for workspaces on other monitors. Leave empty to derive it from the theme (magenta).

schema.label: Hover preview
schema.description: Show the preview card when hovering a workspace number. When off, numbers only switch workspaces on click.

schema.label: Hover delay (ms)
schema.description: How long to hover a number before the preview opens.

schema.label: Preview width (px)
schema.description: Width of the mini screen preview; its height follows the monitor aspect ratio.

schema.label: Live window capture
schema.description: Show live screen captures in the preview. When off, windows are drawn as tiles with their app icon and name.

schema.label: Window list
schema.description: Show the list of windows under the preview.

schema.label: Listed windows
schema.description: Maximum number of windows shown in the list before it summarizes the rest.

schema.label: Highlight last focused window
schema.description: Highlight the most recently focused window of each workspace. When off, only the currently focused window is highlighted.

schema.label: Peek on hover
schema.description: Switch to the workspace while the cursor rests on the preview, and switch back when it leaves. Clicking still switches.

schema.label: Peek delay (ms)
schema.description: How long the cursor must rest on the preview before peeking.
